WHAT: Gemini identification prompt no longer returns a searchQuery string. Instead it returns structured data that the cascade search uses to build optimized queries.

FIELDS: { type (from fixed list), color, brand, model, style, material, gender }

QUERY BUILD LOGIC (in lib/smart-search.ts):
- Has brand + model → 'Nike Air Force 1'
- Has brand, no model → 'Ralph Lauren polo shirt'
- No brand → 'leather belt' or 'slim chinos'
- Accessories: include material + model name for specificity

FIXED TYPE LIST: Constrains Gemini output to types that map 1:1 to catalog IDs. No more 'duffle bag' when it's a 'bag'.

SEARCH PIPELINE: Gemini identifies → structured fields → catalog_id lookup → brand_id lookup (dynamic, cached) → cascade with 6 fallback levels

WHY: Previous approach let Gemini write 'duffle bag' as query — too vague. Separating identification from query building gives better control. The cascade guarantees results even if filters are too narrow.
